title: GridHeader
description: Header (web/public/data/grid/{region}.json) for the heatmap layer stack {region}.bin. The binary is the layers in the order of `layers`, back to back, each described by layer_info. Axis and index convention: see x0.

region.description: Region id (no units); equals the file name.

bins.description: Azimuth bins per cell in the mask layer (unitless count). Bin b covers azimuth b * (360 / bins) degrees clockwise from local north.

layers.description: Layers present in the binary, in file order (no units). A layer without data is left out.

layer_info.description: Storage description of each layer, keyed by layer name; its keys equal `layers`.

mask.description: Terrain horizon elevation per azimuth bin, stored as int16 hundredths of a degree with components = bins.

aspect_deg.description: Compass direction the slope faces (downhill), degrees clockwise from local north in [0, 360); 0 where the cell is flat (slope 0).

roughness_deg.description: Standard deviation of slope (degrees) over a 5 x 5 window of 80 m cells; the rock-distribution proxy input (PIPE-6).

sun_avg.description: Long-term average fraction of time the Sun is visible above the terrain horizon, in [0, 1] (fraction), averaged over the 18.6-year lunar precession cycle (Mazarico et al. 2011, PGDA product 69). Not date-specific.

earth_avg.description: Long-term average fraction of time the Earth is visible above the terrain horizon, in [0, 1] (fraction); a direct-to-Earth radio proxy (Mazarico et al. 2011, PGDA product 69). Not date-specific.

psr.description: Fraction of the cell area that is permanently shadowed, in [0, 1] (fraction), from the LOLA PSR map (Mazarico et al. 2011). PSRs are cold traps where water ice can be stable.

ice_favorability.description: Cannon & Britt 2020 ice favorability model, native 591 m. Model index, not measured ice abundance.

rock.description: Rock-distribution factor in [0, 1] (fraction; 0 = smooth, 1 = rough). Until a polar rock-abundance or boulder raster exists it is a DEM roughness proxy, flagged with proxy: true.

layer.title: GridLayerInfo
layer.description: How one layer is stored. The value for cell index i (= row * nx + col) and component c is the little-endian element at byte_offset + (i * components + c) * itemsize, and its physical value is stored * scale + offset.

dtype.description: Stored element type (no units); itemsize is 1, 2, 2 and 4 bytes.

scale.description: Multiplier from stored value to physical value, in `units` per stored count.

units.description: Unit of the physical value, e.g. deg, m, fraction.

components.description: Values per cell (unitless count): bins for the mask layer, 1 for scalar layers.

nodata.description: STORED value (before scale and offset) that marks a missing cell, or null when every cell is valid.

byte_offset.description: Offset in bytes of the layer's first element from the start of the .bin.

byte_length.description: Length of the layer in bytes: nx * ny * components * itemsize.

proxy.description: True when the layer is a stand-in derived from other data, not a measurement of the quantity it names (no units). Absent means false.

note.description: Short plain-language note on how the layer was derived (no units), e.g. what a proxy stands in for.
